description: This file provides Python bindings and classes for interacting with the mtdev kernel multi-touch transformation library, including device management and event handling.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: A class for managing a mtdev input device, including opening, closing, and retrieving input events.

classes.name: timeval
classes.description: Structure representing time with seconds and microseconds.

classes.name: input_event
classes.description: Structure representing an input event with timestamp, type, code, and value.

classes.name: input_absinfo
classes.description: Structure containing absolute axis information such as value, min, max, fuzz, flat, and resolution.

classes.name: mtdev_caps
classes.description: Structure representing capabilities of the mtdev device, including multitouch data, slot support, and absolute axes info.

classes.name: mtdev
classes.description: Structure representing the mtdev device, including capabilities and state.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Device object, opens the device file, and sets up the mtdev library.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the device and releases resources.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Checks if the device is idle (no events) within a specified timeout.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the next input event from the device.

methods.name: has_mtdata
methods.description: Returns True if the device supports multitouch data.

methods.name: has_slot
methods.description: Returns True if the device supports slot information.

methods.name: has_abs
methods.description: Returns True if the device has absolute axis data at the specified index.

methods.name: get_max_abs
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of absolute axes supported.

methods.name: get_abs
methods.description: Returns absolute axis data at the specified index.
